policy: C scope and fsynced journal before any D mkdir
Source/target ancestors and full trees reject symlink/junction/reparse/nonregular entries
Preflight logical size, file count and free space before physical copy
New target only, no overwrite/hardlink/junction/rename/delete; old source opened read-only
Per-file SHA256 before copy, target readback and source after copy must match
Failure retains partial new target and C journal; no automatic retry or failure reset
